standard_prerequisites.name: A perfect object on a locally ringed space is locally represented by a finite complex of finite free modules
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the local strictly perfect representative.

standard_prerequisites.name: The stalk of a finite free module has dimension equal to its rank, and the cohomology of the derived fiber is computed by the complex of vector spaces
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the value of the function on the open.

core_obligations: Locally represent E by a finite complex of finite free O_X-modules via the cohomology perfect-on-locally-ringed lemma (proof lines 8007-8010).

On such an open the derived fiber of E at any point is represented by the complex of vector spaces obtained from the finite free complex, so the alternating sum of dimensions equals the alternating sum of ranks, a constant (proof lines 8011-8012).
proof_roadmap: Obtain a strictly perfect local representative (proof lines 8007-8010).
Compute the Euler characteristic as the alternating rank sum on that open (proof lines 8011-8012).
